fact: On 10 August 2026 the Justice Ministry's legal undersecretary said that, with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, a draft Law Regulating Data and Artificial Intelligence 2026 had been prepared, alongside draft cybersecurity and digital transformation laws.
title: وكيل وزارة العدل: الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحول الرقمي آفاق جديدة لتطوير المنظومة العدلية
